manifesto.label: Manifesto
manifesto.title: Software can be built differently.
manifesto.lede: We believe in code as a tool for freedom. Few clients, full attention, every decision motivated. No magic formulas, no promises we don't intend to keep.
manifesto.statement_1: Kiba.Studio is a boutique software house based in Milan, made of real people and a curated network. We work with start-ups, SMEs and professionals looking for actual technical quality, not slogans.
manifesto.statement_2: We believe software should be built so that it works, so that it lasts, so that it respects whoever uses it. When the ethical choice costs more or takes longer, we make it anyway. That's what sets us apart, and we put it in writing.

ownership.title: The code is yours.
ownership.description: Repository, accesses, documentation, infrastructure: at the end of the project we hand over everything. You can keep working with us, in-house or with another vendor. No barriers, no retaliation.
ownership.proof: No proprietary lock-in, no closed components you can't modify.

privacy.title: Privacy as the default.
privacy.description: Every technical decision puts data respect first. EU hosting, zero third-party analytics, privacy-friendly alternatives over invasive tools.
privacy.proof: GDPR implemented at the technical level, not as a legal checkbox.

honesty.title: Honest scope and pricing.
honesty.description: Detailed quotes, not approximate flat fees. If a task is taking longer than planned we tell you before, not after the invoice. If we don't know how to do something, we say so instead of improvising.
honesty.proof: Scope changes discussed and approved before being executed.

transparency.title: Technical decisions explained.
transparency.description: Stack, architecture and provider choices are motivated, not imposed. Want to know why we picked Laravel over Node? We'll tell you. Your investment stays understandable.
transparency.proof: Every important decision is documented and reopenable at any time.

process.step_1_description: We start with an in-depth analysis of your business needs, goals and technical constraints. Together we define the best strategy, project scope, realistic timeline and sustainable budget.

autoimporta.summary: B2B platform for the operational management of vehicle imports.
autoimporta.context: The client manually handled most of the import flow, with data scattered across spreadsheets and PDFs. The goal was to unify the process into a single platform, reduce per-case handling time and reliably track the status of each vehicle.
autoimporta.work: Laravel backend with a domain modelled on the client's real processes, Vue 3 single page application frontend, integration with the necessary external providers. EU hosting on Hetzner, verified daily backups, active monitoring.
results: Significantly reduced average handling time per case compared to the manual process
End-to-end tracking of every vehicle's status
Complete operations history for internal audits
autoimporta.note: Specific business and numerical details are covered by NDA. Available on request during a call.

kiba_finance.summary: Personal finance tool. Privacy-first, local data, no account required.
kiba_finance.context: Mainstream personal finance apps require bank access, cloud accounts and behavioural profiling. We wanted to show another way is possible: a useful, local tool you don't need to trust because it never sees your data.
kiba_finance.work: Nuxt single page application with local storage (IndexedDB) and optional sync via client-side encrypted files. No mandatory backend, no analytics, no account. Installable PWA.
results: Zero data transmitted to third parties by design
Data export and portability guaranteed (open format)
kiba_finance.note: Internal project, also a technical showcase of our approach to privacy by design.

sample_ocr.summary: OCR pipeline for data extraction from recurring structured documents.
sample_ocr.context: A growing volume of paper or unstructured PDF documents had to flow into an existing approval system. Manual transcription was the bottleneck.
sample_ocr.work: Python pipeline with image pre-processing, Tesseract OCR, post-processing with domain-specific rules. FastAPI for integration with the client's system. All containerised, on-premise deployment.
results: Drastic reduction in manual data entry time
Modular pipeline reusable for new document types

contatti.faq_title: Frequently asked before the first contact

faqs.q: Do you only work in Italy?
faqs.a: We mostly work in Italy (Italian and English), but we run projects for European clients. All remote by default; in person only if really necessary for the project.

faqs.q: What's the minimum budget to get started?
faqs.a: We don't work on hourly budgets below certain thresholds, but the project has to make sense for both sides. For single-shot consulting we start from a few days of engagement, for full projects typically from a few weeks of development upwards. We orient you on a call before quoting.
Yes, always. Your repositories, your accesses, your documentation. At the end of the project you can take everything and move it wherever you want, even to another vendor.

faqs.q: Do you do maintenance after release?
faqs.a: Yes, but on a separate contract and only if it makes sense for the project. We don't lock you into a mandatory retainer to "keep the keys" of the code. If you'd rather handle it in-house, we train you to do it.

transparency.hero_subtitle: Privacy first, demonstrated. Here we openly state what we load, where the site runs, and what we don't do. Verifiable with any network monitor.
transparency.section_not_title: What this site does NOT do
section_not_items: No Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel, hotjar or similar tools.
No profiling cookies or third-party marketing cookies.
No syncing of your identity with advertising platforms.
No invasive cookie banner, because there's nothing we need your consent for.
transparency.section_not_outro: If you have uBlock Origin or another blocker installed, this site works exactly the same: there's nothing to block.
transparency.section_cookie_p_suffix: , which stores the chosen language. Details in the
transparency.section_resources_intro: The browser loads static resources (fonts and icons) from public CDNs to reduce loading time. These resources don't install cookies but their provider can log the request IP:
transparency.section_resources_outro: We're working to self-host these resources too, removing every third-party request. When done, the change will be noted here.
transparency.section_logs_p: The hosting provider records minimal technical logs (IP, user agent, requested URL, response code) for security and diagnostic purposes. Maximum retention: 30 days, no profiling use.
section_hosting_items: Hosting: EU provider (servers physically in Germany or France, depending on the provider chosen at deploy time).
Domain: managed through a registrar that allows WHOIS privacy.
Email: the address hello{'@'}kiba.studio uses a professional email provider with EU-based servers.
transparency.section_stack_p: For pure transparency: this site is built with Nuxt 4 (Vue.js framework), shipped as a full-stack JavaScript application, animations with GSAP. No tracking-oriented dependencies.
transparency.section_verify_p1: Open your browser's developer tools (F12), "Network" tab, and reload the page. You'll see exactly all the requests made and you can compare them against what's stated above.
transparency.section_verify_p2_prefix: If you find a discrepancy, write to us at
transparency.section_verify_p2_suffix: and we'll fix it: either this page, or the site.
transparency.section_why_p: Selling "privacy first" as a slogan is easy. Making it verifiable is the point. This page exists because we believe technical transparency is the most honest way to demonstrate what we claim.
transparency.meta_description: What the Kiba.Studio site does and doesn't do. Verifiable privacy, EU hosting, zero tracking.
